hooks.command: root="$(command -v env >/dev/null && command -v sed >/dev/null || exit 2; for v in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(GIT_[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do unset "$v"; done; git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && node "$root/tools/forbidden-tools.js" || { echo '禁區攔截器起不來（找不到檔、沒有 node、載入就崩）：一律當成拒絕' >&2; exit 2; }
